## Requirements

| requirement | disposition |
|---|---|
| SIG-EVUI-001 (owner) | `/evidence/` is the artifact index over `web/evidence.json` (`sig.evidence-artifact/1`): the state-of-the-evidence roll-up (artifacts, run records, captures, captures with stored bytes, claim views), the browse-artifacts list (≤50 rows, `/evidence/page/<n>/` per K9 §6.1), every row carrying human title, source, type, classification, lane, capture status and the upstream cell; facet lists under `/evidence/source|type|lane|state|place/<id>/` each paginated. MET |
| SIG-EVUI-002 (owner) | `/evidence/artifact/<E-handle>/` renders the §4.2 blocks — human title (a UUID-shaped recorded title composes `<source> — <type> (run <date>)`, never a bare id), source, type, place, classification, lane, upstream (S-6 publication form), the capture history table, claims supported, contradictions, status, rights, used-by, equivalent requests + cite — every field a value or a named absence; `/evidence/<id>/` answers a noindex moved stub + the JUR-05 generator's `301 → /evidence/claim/<id>/`. MET |
| SIG-EVUI-003 (owner) | every capture row shows its classification; `synthetic` renders the verbatim `run record — SIG did not store this document` label; `view_original` renders the minted label/href only — no bytes or download-original where the lane/href forbids. MET |
| SIG-EVUI-005 (owner) | the §4.4 diff (`/evidence/artifact/<h>/diff/<a>..<b>/`) mints only where BOTH captures of the same artifact carry extracted `fields` — real captures only; export rows carry no field map, so no pair mints and the fixture pair never leaks into an export build. MET |
| SIG-EVUI-006 (owner) | the eligibility gate is structural — `getEvidence()` drops withheld/withdrawn artifacts before any route mints, so an ineligible artifact gets no page and lists on no index. MET |
| SIG-EVUI-008 (owner) | the current-state banner + `EmptyState evidenceIndex` name the actual cause (run-level records / no published artifacts) — never a "research gap". MET |
| SIG-EVUI-010 (consumption) | `E-<place>-<code>-<slug>-<hash4>` handles per K11 §3 (Crockford sha256 of `artifact_id`, place-tail drop, org abbreviations, ≤24-char slug, ≤64 chars, collision pass 4→8 deterministic); the producer-side `evidence_handles_history.json` map is a later row — `getHandleHistories()` already reads it when emitted. MET within release |
| SIG-UI-039/040 | cited — every new route is T1 zero-JS in `page-types.ts` (`/evidence/**` owner → P36.60); no-JS parity asserted by the sweeps |
| SIG-ENG-042 | cited — a claim id colliding with a reserved segment fails the build; ineligible artifacts mint no page; `handle` collisions fail loud past hash-8 |
| plan cell decisions | `D-K8-4 [B-44] = as recommended: show the 255 synthetic run-record artifacts with honest labels` — carried verbatim |
